rules.evidence: Each deduction requires a quote or documented absence check, evidence location and retrieval method; unknown inspection is not absence.
rules.incomplete: Any applicable not_measured check withholds final score; show earned completed points and status. Unknown category leaves C2 unmeasured.
rules.notApplicable: Only explicit versioned rules permit exclusions; redistribute within the criterion. An empty criterion withholds final score; never redistribute across pillars.
rules.delivery: S1 initial readable HTML full, rendered-only half, state blob or interaction-only zero; failed rendering unmeasured. S2 rendered-only multiplies otherwise eligible points by one half.
rules.rounding: Keep full precision; round displayed criterion scores to one decimal and derive overall from unrounded values.
rules.claimLimits: Measures rubric evidence, not citations, traffic, ranking or recommendation probability; sources support practices, not editorial weights.
specialRules: S1 specifications average applicable category attributes.

S2 core properties equal thirds; offer price with currency and availability each one point; brand and identifier each one point, merchant SKU alone half identifier; exclude variants for truly single configuration.
S3 no markup scores zero; optional claims absent exclude optional-claims, except no markup. Compare same variant, market, currency and conditions.
S5 search bots split equally; retrieval pool split equally; training and user-triggered agents unscored; unresolved access unmeasured.
C2 pools split equally among applicable attributes.
C3 inspect linked policies; link alone is insufficient.
C4 average applicable category questions within their assigned subcheck.
C5 average applicable consistency groups and material claims; exclude claim-support when no claims require substantiation.
rules.context: Record audited URL, final URL, canonical, variant, market, currency, audit time, rubric, category and extraction/judge versions.

schemaValidationPolicy.scope: Project interpretation for S2; platform feature eligibility requirements do not establish universal AI requirements.
schemaValidationPolicy.entity: Recognize a parseable schema.org Product associated with the audited product; ambiguous association is partial, malformed or unreliable extraction earns no credit for affected fields. Unknown extraction is not_measured.

coreProperties.scoring: Divide two points equally. Values must be meaningful and associated with the audited product.

offer.scoring: One point for price and currency together; one for availability. Associate the Offer with the selected product and market.

identifiers.scoring: One point each for brand and identifier. Validate GTIN format and check digit when used; appropriate manufacturer identifiers may qualify; merchant SKU alone receives half the identifier point. Exclude a genuinely inapplicable identifier only under a versioned category rule.

schemaValidationPolicy.variants: Variants and offers must be distinguishable and associated with the correct configuration. Exclude the subcheck for a verified single-configuration product.
schemaValidationPolicy.delivery: Recognized markup available only after ordinary rendering earns half of otherwise eligible credit. A failed rendering inspection is not_measured.
schemaValidationPolicy.provenance: Record format, source location, raw or rendered retrieval, selected variant and validation outcome. Inaccessible or ambiguous evidence is not proof of invalidity.
